review_slices.scope: Soundness closure: shared declared-vertex/visibility function for row acceptance AND applicability/transport; declared vertices subset of visible(plane) when syndrome_plane present; noncover binding to the transported proper_delete_1_color for missing-vertex orbits lacking an n9 certificate (orbits {1,8},{2,5,9,10},{3,4,6,7}); typed source-location validation (exact int for array positions; literal keys "2"/"3" bound to exact-int missing_vertex for the frozen n9 dictionary member; root null only for the five named standalone scalar-source members) with one shared locator function driving dedupe; n9 inner multiplier; duplicate descriptors; every row/action/target/weight path that changed. Report any NEW path to a VALID status that v4 did not have.

Fail-closed closure and PJ: PJ coverage or explicit unsupported status for aux-determined and functional-local-fd; single-LF prefix check at the pinned offset; bounded reads and re-hash before use; distinct timeout versus definite rejection outcomes; signal handling and exclusive output; exit codes; JSON strictness parity between v5 and PJ v2; that the author diff summary matches the actual changed lines (no undocumented change); that frozen v4/v1 bytes are unchanged.

review_contract.verification: Static read only. No program execution, import, compilation, test, R382 diagnostic or archive replay. Prior PASS/receipt claims are non-evidence.
review_contract.coverage: Read both successor files completely and the predecessor files for diff context; cite exact file:line for every finding; distinguish code findings from conditional scientific premises (written lift/tensorization, FD persistence, k=1 colouring remain WRITTEN obligations).
review_contract.output: Write ONLY your assigned review file in this wave directory with the write tool; if the write tool refuses the repository path, return the complete review as your final tool output and say so explicitly (the parent will materialize it verbatim). Do not edit any other file.
review_contract.findings: FATAL = reachable false-accept on declared inputs; MAJOR = latent false-accept path or whole-category false-reject; MINOR otherwise. State explicitly whether each f264 item 1-8 is CLOSED, PARTIALLY CLOSED or OPEN, and whether a bulk-replay GO is recommended (parent decides).
review_contract.prohibitions: No build/lint/tests/formatters, git, commits, push, deletion, external publication/model, paid action or live infrastructure.
